guides.title: Mend a torn sail
guides.body:
This guide is made up for the tests. The kite workshop in it does not exist. A torn sail is patched with ripstop film before the kite flies again.

## Before you start

Dry the sail and brush off any sand. Lay it flat on the bench.

## Patch the tear

1. Cut a round patch of ripstop film, bigger than the tear.
2. Press the patch onto the front and the back of the sail and leave it under a heavy book for an hour.

## Troubleshooting

If the patch peels off, wipe the sail with a damp rag and press on a fresh patch.

guides.title: Replace a snapped spar
guides.body:
## Fit the new spar

Slide the snapped spar out of its sleeve. Measure it, cut a carbon rod to the same length, and push the rod into the sleeve until it clicks.

## Related articles

- [Mend a torn sail](/help/en/autoserv-pro/mend-a-torn-sail)

guides.title: Common questions about the workshop
guides.body:
Short answers to what visitors ask most often.

## Can I leave my kite overnight?

Yes. Lockers are free for a single night.

## Do you repair stunt kites?

Yes, but only models with two handles.

## Is the workshop open on Sunday?

No. It is closed on Sunday and on Monday.

## Can I pay by card?

Yes. Coins and cards are both accepted at the counter.

## Related articles

- [Send a pickup reminder](/help/en/autoserv-pro/send-a-pickup-reminder)

guides.title: Send a pickup reminder
guides.body:
When a repair is ready, the owner is told to collect the kite.

## Send the reminder by SMS

Open the repair ticket and press Remind. The owner receives an SMS with the pickup code.

## Troubleshooting

If the SMS does not arrive, check the phone number on the repair ticket and press Remind again.

## Related articles
